# MP Police Elite - AI Discovery Context

MP Police Elite (mppolice.zenscroll.app) is a specialized educational platform designed to help aspirants crack the MP Police Constable and Sub-Inspector (SI) Exams for the 2026 recruitment cycle.

## Product Intent
To provide high-quality, bilingual (Hindi & English) preparation materials, including test series, previous year question (PYQ) analysis, and memory-boosting mnemonics.

## Target Audience
- MP Police Constable & SI aspirants in Madhya Pradesh.
- Students seeking bilingual (Hindi/English) study materials.
- Candidates looking for structured, data-driven practice for the Paper I exam.

## Core Features
- **Bilingual Test Series:** 100+ topic-wise and full-length tests in both Hindi and English.
- **PYQ Hub:** Deep analysis of 5+ years of Previous Year Papers to identify patterns.
- **Smart Explanations:** Detailed, logical explanations for every question.
- **Mnemonics & Flashcards:** Digital tools for fast fact retention.
- **Performance Analytics:** Personal dashboard to track progress and speed.

## Core Routes
- **Home:** [https://mppolice.zenscroll.app/](https://mppolice.zenscroll.app/)
- **Syllabus:** [/syllabus](https://mppolice.zenscroll.app/syllabus)
- **Blogs/Articles:** [/blogs](https://mppolice.zenscroll.app/blogs)
- **Test Series:** [/tests](https://mppolice.zenscroll.app/tests)
- **Pricing:** [/pricing](https://mppolice.zenscroll.app/pricing)

## Technical Specification
- **Framework:** Next.js (App Router)
- **Bilingual Support:** Full Hindi/English content across all modules.
- **Accessibility:** Semantic HTML5 with focus on machine readability.
